name: Mirai Sarutobi
source:
Mirai Sarutobi is a kunoichi of Konohagakure's Sarutobi clan. Mirai hair is black, short and unruly and she has has red, ringed irides — both of which she inherited from her mother. Mirai is the child of [url=https://vndb.org/c109619]Kurenai Yūhi[/url] and Asuma Sarutobi, born in the depths of Autumn. Her name was chosen by Asuma in belief of protecting the future well-being of the children of the world. While growing up, she was watched over regularly by Shikamaru Nara, as it was his final promise to Mirai's late father. During which, Mirai became very close to Shikamaru.
